name: (Neg)Entropic Wandering
source:
"Each path is an endless dead-end I find myself halfway down in both directions."

[From [url=https://ryan-nein.itch.io/negentropic-wandering]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“每条路都是无尽的死胡同，我发现自己在两个方向上都半路走下去。”

[来自[url=https://ryan-nein.itch.io/negentropic-wandering]Itch.io[/url]]
